map.LPR 四倍是怎么算的？: How is the four-times LPR cap calculated?
map.→ 打开民间借贷利息计算工具: -> Open the private lending interest calculator tool
map.以合同成立时或起诉时（各地司法口径不同）全国银行间同业拆借中心公布的一年期贷款市: Based on the one-year Loan Prime Rate (LPR) published by the National Interbank Funding Center at the time the contract was formed or at the time of filing (judicial practice differs by region), multiplied by 4 as the judicial protection cap.
map.出借前核算借款在约定利率下的总利息与月供，判断是否超过法定保护上限。: Before lending, compute the total interest and monthly payment at the agreed rate to judge whether it exceeds the statutory protection cap.
map.受保护年利率 ≤ 合同成立时一年期 LPR × 4; 利息 = 本金 × 有效年: Protected annual rate <= the one-year LPR at contract formation × 4; interest = principal × effective annual rate × months / 12
map.已支付超过上限利息的，借款人可主张抵扣本金或返还。: Where interest above the cap has already been paid, the borrower may claim it against the principal or demand its return.
map.按本金、利率与期限计算借贷利息与还款总额，并校验是否超过 LPR 四倍法定利率上: Compute the lending interest and total repayment from the principal, rate and term, and check whether it exceeds the statutory cap of four times the LPR, helping assess lending compliance. Pure front-end reference.
map.有约定从约定但同样受 LPR 四倍上限约束；既未约定借期内利率也未约定逾期利率的: Where there is an agreement, follow it, but it is still bound by the four-times LPR cap; where neither the in-term rate nor the overdue rate is agreed, interest for the use of funds may be claimed with reference to the one-year LPR at the time.
map.民间借贷利息计算 使用指南: How to use the private lending interest calculator
map.民间借贷利率受司法保护上限约束，约定年利率超过合同成立时一年期贷款市场报价利率（: Private lending interest is bound by the judicial protection cap: any agreed annual rate above four times the one-year Loan Prime Rate (LPR) at contract formation is not supported by the court; interest is actually charged at an effective rate not exceeding that cap, and an instalment repayment plan can be produced.
map.约定利率超过合同成立时一年期 LPR 四倍的部分，法院不予保护。: The portion of an agreed rate above four times the one-year LPR at contract formation is not protected by the court.
map.逾期利率怎么定？: How is the overdue rate set?
map.：月利率 1%，月供 = 100000 × 0.01 × (1.01^12) /: : monthly rate 1%, monthly payment = 100000 x 0.01 x (1.01^12) / ((1.01^12) - 1) ≈ 8,885 CNY, 12 instalments total about 106,618 CNY, and the total interest is about 6,618 CNY.
map.：设一年期 LPR 3.45%，四倍上限 = 13.8%；约定年利率 12% <: : with a one-year LPR of 3.45%, the four-times cap is 13.8%; an agreed 12% annual rate is below 13.8% and is protected, while an agreed 15% leaves the 1.2 percentage point excess unprotected.
